observed_problem: The SP001 Pilot registry duplicates a reduced editorial scope (lineage, distribution, reasoning, coding) instead of referencing the authoritative TS-001 planning document. Because ChatGPT is the research operator, duplicating thematic scope into bootstrap configuration creates a stale second authority and can narrow research before the agent reads the backlog.
expected_behavior: Thematic bootstrap should identify the target planning authority and stable production identity, then require ChatGPT to read the canonical backlog/series guide to construct the Production Profile and initial research obligations. Edition-specific scope belongs in the planning document/Profile, not duplicated Pilot literals or generic Core code.
actual_behavior: config/survey-production-v2-pilots.json currently embeds a four-dimension SP001 scope that is narrower than docs/thematic-special-backlog.md, and survey_pilot_bootstrap_v2.py treats those registry literals as immutable launch identity.
production_workaround: Do not initialize SP001 until bootstrap authority is changed to reference TS-001 planning scope. Do not fix this by copying the entire backlog into another JSON registry.

provenance.human_review_reference: User premise correction and ChatGPT-first pre-approval re-audit, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Implement WU-012E: make SP001 bootstrap reference the canonical TS-001 planning authority and let the agent materialize Profile obligations from that authority, while keeping only stable identity/path/as-of mechanics in bootstrap configuration.
